name: Ikiru Sono Saki ni -Episode Awakening-
original_name: 生きるその先に -覚醒編-
source:
One night, Yoshizawa Natsuo, who had moved to Tokyo before entering university, met a mysterious girl. 

A girl with silvery white hair and crimson eyes said in a cold voice, "My name is Kishou. Your Shinigami." The bewildered Natsuo is given two weeks to live by the Shinigami, who called herself Kishou.

"In two weeks, I will die...?"

When he was suddenly told the time limit of his life, what flashed through Natsuo's mind was the voice of his first love, who had broken up with him when he was a child.

"I think there will be a lot of painful and sad things in the future."

If he truly was going to die, he wanted to see her one more time.

Relying on his faint memories, Natsuo headed to the place he remembered.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/ikiru-story]official website[/url]]
translation:
一个晚上，在进入大学之前搬到东京的吉泽夏男遇到了一位神秘的女孩。

一名银白头发、猩红双眸的少女冷声说道：“我叫鬼翔，你的死神。”自称鬼将的死神给了不知所措的夏夫两周的生命。

“两周后，我就会死……？”

当他突然被告知生命的期限时，夏尾的脑海中闪过的是小时候与他分手的初恋情人的声音。

“我想，未来还会有很多痛苦和悲伤的事情。”

如果他真的要死了，他还想再见她一面。

夏尾凭借着微弱的记忆，前往记忆中的地方。

[翻译自[url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/ikiru-story]官网[/url]]
